_comment: camwatch deployment config. All _rel keys are resolved relative to this file's directory. TOKEN is NEVER stored in this file by design — it comes from an environment variable or the env_file dotfile (see README §3).

cameras._note_example_camera: Example entry — replace ALL values with your own camera. One object per device; 'root' must be the base URL only (scheme + host (+ port if not 80), no path, ideally no trailing slash).
cameras.name: Front door (example)

_note_tg_chat_id: Numeric Telegram chat id (groups/supergroups are negative). Find it: README §4. Empty value here = dry-run start (everything works, no sending).
_note_poll_interval_sec: Per-camera poll period in seconds. The code clamps any value below the hard floor of 2 s up to 2 s — smaller numbers are ignored by design.
_note_confirm_frames: Consecutive hits required before inference/alert (default 3; single noise blips never fire). Any value below 1 is raised to 1 by the code.
_note_cpu_threads: Inference threads; deliberately low so normal machine work stays smooth (CPU-only inference, GPU untouched).

windows_by_weekday_min._comment_windows_format: Minutes since midnight per weekday. Each entry is a half-open [start; end) pair — the stop moment itself counts as OUTSIDE (no polling at that exact minute). Weekday index: Monday = "0" ... Sunday = "6". An empty list means that day is never polled. All times are local time of the host.
windows_by_weekday_min._note_mon_example: Mon example only — edit to your own hours (08:00–13:00 and 23:00–midnight here).
